highlights.title: Agentic Browser Security: 2025 Year-End Review | Wiz Blog
highlights.summary: An Agentic Browser is an AI-powered co-pilot that not only reads the web, it acts on it. By understanding page content and executing multi-step tasks autonomously, these agents can book flights, shop, and fill out forms without step-by-step human guidance.
